# LTL Language School

> > LTL Language School offers immersive language courses in Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Vietnamese across Asia with homestay programs and CSN accreditation.

Founded in 2007 in Beijing, LTL has expanded to become Asia's leading language school with locations in Shanghai, Chengde, Tokyo, Osaka, Seoul, Hanoi, and Ho Chi Minh City. The school specializes in small group classes, individual lessons, and cultural immersion programs including gap years, summer camps, and master classes for learners of all ages.

## Key Topics

- Chinese immersion programs
- Japanese language courses
- Korean language learning
- Vietnamese language study
- Homestay programs

- Language learning in Beijing, Shanghai, Tokyo, Osaka, Seoul, Hanoi
